Message:
qed*: Semantic changes

Make semantic-only adjustments to qed* drivers, such as:
  - Changes in code indentation.
  - Usage of BIT() macro.
  - re-naming of variables.
  - Re-ordering of variable declerations.
  - Removal of (== 0) and (!= 0) in conditions.
